Get catch from official record. 
Filter out catch for artisanal fisheries and eliminate aquaculture production.
Uses table with corrected names to standarize names of locations and fishery offices and correct incorrect state names.
Combines catch files for all years and selects landing site, state, fishery office, species, weight, and catch value.
Resulting data is imported as catch rmd into the package

```{r get catch data, echo=TRUE}

locs.pesca <- clean_locs_pesca()

ents.coast.selecc <- toupper(c("Baja California Sur", "Baja California", "Sonora", "Sinaloa", "Nayarit", "Jalisco"))
coast.selecc <- stringi::stri_trans_general(str = ents.coast.selecc, id = "Latin-ASCII")

#Currently only using data 2018-2023, other data have too many inconsistencies
#catch.files <- list.files(path = here::here("data-raw","original_fisheries_data"), full.names = TRUE)
catch.files <- list.files(path = here::here("data-raw","original_fisheries_data"), full.names = TRUE, pattern = "2018|2019|2020|2021|2022|2023")

no.catchfiles <- 1:length(catch.files)

#NOTE: There are 16,531 records between 2000-2004 with 0 price for catch

#parallel::mclapply(no.catchfiles, get_catch, catch.files, coast.selecc, locs.pesca)
#use lapply for debugging
lapply(no.catchfiles, get_catch, catch.files, coast.selecc, locs.pesca)

catch.files.clean <- list.files(path = here::here("data-raw","fisheries_data"), full.names = TRUE)
no.catchfiles.clean <- 1:length(catch.files.clean)

catchdata <- lapply(no.catchfiles.clean, clean_catch, catch.files.clean) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
  mutate(catch_id = paste0("catch_",1:nrow(.)))

usethis::use_data(catchdata, overwrite = TRUE)
#creates template describing the data
data.description <-sinew::makeOxygen(catchdata)
cat(data.description, file=here::here("R",paste0("data-","catchdata")))

#rebuild and load the package
devtools::load_all() # restarts and loads


```


Gets list of fishery offices from catch records
Uses standarized catch data to get unique fishery offices and georeference them
```{r Get fishery offices}

locs.pesca <- clean_locs_pesca()

#get unique georeferenced rnp codes

data("inegigc")
data("catchdata")

fishery.offices.list <- get_fishery_office_catch(catchdata) 

#fishery office list for 2024 is available here https://www.conapesca.gob.mx/work/sites/cona/dgppe/Subdelegaciones_de_Pesca.pdf
#the La Reforma office is in the Municipality of Angostura and has CVE_LOC = 250020093
#there are locations named La Reforma sites in Sinaloa so had to be extracted manually

fishery.office.table <- fishery.offices.list %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(NOM_LOC,NOM_ENT)

fishery.spatial <- sf::st_as_sf(fishery.office.table, coords = c("deci_lon", "deci_lat"), crs = 4326) %>% 
  sf::st_transform(4269)

fishery.spatial %>% 
  sf::st_write(here::here("outputs","fishery_offices.shp"), append=FALSE)

readr::write_csv(fishery.office.table, here::here("outputs","fishery_offices.csv"))

fisheryoffice <- fishery.office.table
  
usethis::use_data(fisheryoffice, overwrite = TRUE)
#creates template describing the data
data.description <-sinew::makeOxygen(fisheryoffice)
cat(data.description, file=here::here("R",paste0("data-","fisheryoffice")))

#rebuild and load the package
devtools::load_all() # restarts and loads




```

Create table georeferrenced locations from INEGI & Google and add distance to nearest fishery office

```{r location table, echo=TRUE}

locs.pesca <- clean_locs_pesca()

correct.ent <- locs.pesca %>%
    select(-NOM_LOC_REV)

correct.loc <- locs.pesca %>%
    select(-NOM_ENT_REV) 

ents.coast.selecc <- toupper(c("Baja California Sur", "Baja California", "Sonora", "Sinaloa", "Nayarit", "Jalisco"))
coast.selecc <- stringi::stri_trans_general(str = ents.coast.selecc, id = "Latin-ASCII")

#will extract all locations within states, not only coastal areas
#only run once will create attached data
#get_inegi(ents.coast.selecc)

data("inegigc")

locs.census <- inegigc %>% 
   select(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC, deci_lat, deci_lon)
  
#get georeferenced locations from inegi
locs.inegi <- googlesheets4::read_sheet("1Nww_0aSf2yQv9YqK8LqmJmIM2wwpHZCSpG1NcGfIfHQ", sheet = "busqueda_inegi") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(deci_lat=latitud, deci_lon=longitud) %>% 
  keep_when(utilizar == 1) %>% 
  keep_when(NOM_ENT %in% coast.selecc) %>% 
  select(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC, deci_lat, deci_lon)

#test for duplicates 
dupes.inegi <- locs.inegi %>% 
  group_by(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC) %>% 
  mutate(dupe = dplyr::n()>1) %>% 
  keep_when(dupe == TRUE)

#get georeferenced locations from google
locs.google <- googlesheets4::read_sheet("1Nww_0aSf2yQv9YqK8LqmJmIM2wwpHZCSpG1NcGfIfHQ", sheet = "busqueda_google") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(NOM_LOC=NOM_LOC_REV, deci_lat=lat, deci_lon=lon) %>% 
  keep_when(NOM_ENT %in% coast.selecc) %>% 
  keep_when(utilizar == 1) %>% 
  mutate(deci_lon=as.numeric(deci_lon), deci_lat=as.numeric(deci_lat)) %>% 
  select(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC, deci_lat, deci_lon)

#test for duplicates 
dupes.google <- locs.google %>% 
  group_by(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC) %>% 
  mutate(dupe = dplyr::n()>1)

#Atlas fishing locations Pacific
locs.pesca.pacifico <- googlesheets4::read_sheet("1KxO30FqYed655frJDiLobx3N-slFNpNLpHnbxE4cLcI") %>% 
  dplyr::rename(NOM_ENT= ESTADO, NOM_LOC = LOCALIDAD_REVISADA) %>% 
  mutate(NOM_ENT= stringi::stri_trans_general(str = NOM_ENT, id = "Latin-ASCII"), NOM_ENT = toupper(NOM_ENT)) %>% 
  mutate(NOM_LOC = stringi::stri_trans_general(str = NOM_LOC, id = "Latin-ASCII"), NOM_LOC = toupper(NOM_LOC)) %>% 
  select(-LOCALIDAD_ORIGINAL, -ID) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(deci_lat =LATITUD, deci_lon=LONGITUD) %>% 
  keep_when(NOM_ENT %in% coast.selecc) %>% 
   select(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC, deci_lat, deci_lon)


#test for duplicates 
dupes.pacifico <- locs.pesca.pacifico %>% 
  group_by(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC) %>% 
  mutate(dupe = dplyr::n()>1)

#combine all locations
georef.locs <- dplyr::bind_rows(locs.census, locs.inegi, locs.google, locs.pesca.pacifico) %>% 
  distinct(NOM_ENT, NOM_LOC, deci_lat, deci_lon) 

#make spatial

georef.locs.sp <- georef.locs %>% 
  sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("deci_lon", "deci_lat"), crs = 4326) %>% 
  sf::st_transform(4269)

#Add distance to nearest fishery office to help resolve duplicates when georeferincing a catch 

fishery.offices <- sf::st_read(here::here("outputs","fishery_offices.shp")) %>%   sf::st_transform(crs = 4326) %>% 
  sf::st_centroid() 

num.georef.locs <- 1:nrow(georef.locs.sp)

NumberOfCluster <- parallel::detectCores()  #- 1

georef.locs.dist <- parallel::mclapply(num.georef.locs, get_distance, fishery.offices, mc.cores = NumberOfCluster) %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows() 


georeflocskm <- georef.locs.dist %>% 
  mutate(distance_km = distance / 1000)

readr::write_csv(georeflocskm, here::here("outputs","georef_locations.csv"))

usethis::use_data(georeflocskm, overwrite = TRUE)
#creates template describing the data
data.description <-sinew::makeOxygen(georeflocskm)
cat(data.description, file=here::here("R",paste0("data-","georeflocskm")))

#rebuild and load the package
devtools::load_all() # restarts and loads

```

Get permit information from the Registro Nacional de Pesca y Acuacultura RNPA and georeference
https://www.gob.mx/conapesca/documentos/registro-nacional-de-pesca-y-acuacultura-rnpa

```{r Get permit data, echo=TRUE, message=TRUE, warning=TRUE}

data("georeflocskm")

locs.pesca <- clean_locs_pesca()

ents.coast.selecc <- toupper(c("Baja California Sur", "Baja California", "Sonora", "Sinaloa", "Nayarit", "Jalisco"))
coast.selecc <- stringi::stri_trans_general(str = ents.coast.selecc, id = "Latin-ASCII")

inegi.cost.comm.all  <- readr::read_csv(here::here("inputs","all_coastal_communities_INEGI.csv")) %>% 
  mutate(NOM_ENT= stringi::stri_trans_general(str = NOM_ENT, id = "Latin-ASCII"), NOM_ENT = toupper(NOM_ENT)) %>% 
  mutate(NOM_MUN = stringi::stri_trans_general(str = NOM_MUN, id = "Latin-ASCII"), NOM_MUN = toupper(NOM_MUN)) %>% 
  mutate(NOM_LOC = stringi::stri_trans_general(str = NOM_LOC, id = "Latin-ASCII"), NOM_LOC = toupper(NOM_LOC)) %>% 
  keep_when(NOM_ENT %in% coast.selecc)

inegi.cost.mun <- inegi.cost.comm.all %>% 
  distinct(NOM_MUN, CVE_MUN)

permit.files <- list.files(path = here::here("data-raw","permit_data"), full.names = TRUE)
no.permitfiles <- 1:length(permit.files)

permit.data <- lapply(no.permitfiles, extract_permits, permit.files, coast.selecc, locs.pesca, georeflocskm)

permitdata <- permit.data %>% 
  dplyr::bind_rows() %>% 
  distinct(rnp_code, NOM_LOC, NOM_ENT, deci_lat, deci_lon, fishery_office, fishery_office_ent, distance_km)


usethis::use_data(permitdata, overwrite = TRUE)
#creates template describing the data
data.description <-sinew::makeOxygen(permitdata)
cat(data.description, file=here::here("R",paste0("data-","permitdata")))

#rebuild and load the package
devtools::load_all() # restarts and loads

readr::write_csv(permitdata, here::here("outputs","rnp_fishery_permits.csv"))


```

Download GLORYS data
```{r download GLORYS, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# Script to download GLORYS data directly from Copernicus Servers
# Requires a Copernicus marine service account
# https://data.marine.copernicus.eu/products

#mount storage bucket

#if cannot connect to servers
# sudo systemd-resolve --flush-caches
# sudo resolvectl flush-caches
# sudo nmcli general reload dns-full
#to mount bucket 
#https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/gcsfuse-mount#authenticate_requests
#https://medium.com/google-cloud/how-to-use-gcs-bucket-with-gcp-vm-using-gsutil-and-mounting-as-a-filesystem-9139b812db84
#this can also be run if you lose write access to the storage bucket
#gcloud auth application-default login --no-launch-browser
#gcsfuse cedo_model_data storagebucket


#system("sudo chmod -R a+rwx ~/storagebucket/GLORYS", wait = TRUE)

#Install and load dependencies
#system("pip install motuclient==1.8.4")
#install.packages("reticulate")
library(reticulate)
library(lubridate)
#only need to create environment first time
#install_python() 
#virtualenv_create(envname = "copernicus")
#virtualenv_install("copernicus", packages = c("copernicusmarine"))
use_virtualenv("copernicus", required = TRUE)
#py_install("copernicusmarine")

cm <- import("copernicusmarine")

#Specify lat/lon/depth bounds
#Gulf of California 
#-116.1407,20.44,-105.1029,32.0482
#Southeast limit at Cabo Corrientes 20.43386153865933, -105.69209230968688

min_lon <- -116.1407
max_lon <- -105.1000
min_lat  <- 20.4339
max_lat  <- 32.0482

#only needed once unless credentials need to be updated
#cm$login("hmorzarialuna", "#esBmZe7P_H7r_i")

#Set directories
out_dir = paste0("~/storagebucket/GLORYS/monthly")

#Specify GLORYS file from manual https://catalogue.marine.copernicus.eu/documents/PUM/CMEMS-GLO-PUM-001-030.pdf

#GLORYS monthly available time series is 04/12/1991 to 31/06/2021
data.set.id <- "cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg_P1M-m"
var.id <- "thetao"
#set time period
#start.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("2018-01-01"), length=42, by="1 month") 
#end.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("2018-02-01"), length=42, by="1 month") - 1
start.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("2018-01-01"), length=8, by="1 month") 
end.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("2018-02-01"), length=8, by="1 month") - 1
#set length of time period
entry.interval <- 1:length(start.time.interval)
#download data
lapply(entry.interval, get_monthlyglorys, start.time.interval, end.time.interval, min_lon, max_lon, min_lat, max_lat, out_dir, data.set.id)


#GLORYS monthly available time series is 01/07/2021 to M-4 (current month - 4), need to get data 01/07/2021 12/31/2023
data.set.id <- "cmems_mod_glo_phy_myint_0.083deg_P1M-m"
var.id <- "thetao"
#set time period
start.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("2021-07-01"), length=30, by="1 month") 
end.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("2021-08-01"), length=30, by="1 month") - 1
#set lenght of time period
entry.interval <- 1:length(start.time.interval)
#download data
lapply(entry.interval, get_monthlyglorys, start.time.interval, end.time.interval, min_lon, max_lon, min_lat, max_lat, out_dir, data.set.id)

#Get GLORYS data prior to 2018 for climatology
#GLORYS monthly available time series is 04/12/1991 to 31/06/2021
data.set.id <- "cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg_P1M-m"
var.id <- "thetao"
#set time period
start.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("1994-01-01"), length=288, by="1 month") 
end.time.interval <- seq(as.Date("1994-02-01"), length=288, by="1 month") - 1
#set length of time period
entry.interval <- 1:length(start.time.interval)
#download data
lapply(entry.interval, get_monthlyglorys, start.time.interval, end.time.interval, min_lon, max_lon, min_lat, max_lat, out_dir, data.set.id)

#1993-2016 climatology
data.set.id <- "cmems_mod_glo_phy_my_0.083deg-climatology_P1M-m"
out_dir = paste0("~/storagebucket/GLORYS/climatology")

#download data
get_climatologyglorys(min_lon, max_lon, min_lat, max_lat, out_dir, data.set.id)
```

Aggregate depth bins to match projections of CMIP6 data

```{r}
glorys.files <- list.files(path = "/home/atlantis/storagebucket/GLORYS/monthly", pattern="*01.nc$", full.names = TRUE)

#need to aggregate initial depth bins because projected future data starts at 6 m and it is not possible to interpolate to smaller bins
ClimateOperators::cdo("zaxisdes",glorys.files[1])  #shows depth, z axis
ClimateOperators::cdo("sinfon",glorys.files[1])  #shows depth, z axis
    agg.lev <- 7.92956 #will select all depths below this one for aggregation
    max.lev <- 34.43415 #max level for selecting

lapply(glorys.files,agg_depth_bin, agg.lev, max.lev)

```


Get temperature data for each point

```{r Get temp data per point, echo=FALSE}
#Get temperature for each point from closest raster cell 
#uses disaggregated temperature files

this.depth <- 10 #Most species are not caught deeper
# gc.ocean.grid <- sf::st_read(dsn="outputs/goc_grid.shp") %>% 
#   dplyr::mutate(id_pol=1:nrow(.))

catch.pacific.spatial <- sf::st_read(dsn="outputs/gpkg_grid.gpkg", layer='goc_catch') %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(catch_id = 1:nrow(.)) %>% 
    mutate(month_no = dplyr::case_when(
      month  == "DICIEMBRE" ~ "12",
      month == "NOVIEMBRE" ~ "11",
      month == "OCTUBRE" ~ "10",
      month == "SEPTIEMBRE" ~ "09",
      month == "AGOSTO" ~ "08",
      month == "JULIO" ~ "07",
      month == "JUNIO" ~ "06",
      month == "MAYO" ~ "05",
      month == "ABRIL" ~ "04",
      month == "MARZO" ~ "03",
      month == "FEBRERO" ~ "02",
      month == "ENERO" ~ "01"))
#Southeast limit at Cabo Corrientes 20.43386153865933, -105.69209230968688

catch.geo <- catch.pacific.spatial %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(deci_lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
                  deci_lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2]) %>% 
    dplyr::as_tibble() %>% 
    select(-geom) 

years.data <- rep(seq(from=2018, to=2023), each = 12)
start.time.interval <- paste(years.data,c("01","02","03","04","05","06","07","08","09","10","11","12"), sep = "-")

time.interval <- 1:length(start.time.interval)

glorys.files <- list.files(path = "/home/atlantis/storagebucket/GLORYS/monthly_original", full.names = TRUE)

NumberOfCluster <- parallel::detectCores()  #- 1

datapoints <- parallel::mclapply(time.interval, get_nearestpointtemp, this.depth, catch.pacific.spatial, glorys.files, catch.geo, start.time.interval, out.dir = "/home/atlantis/storagebucket/GLORYS/pointtemp", mc.cores = NumberOfCluster)


plot.catch <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = catch.pacific.spatial, ggplot2::aes(x= year, y = landed_w_kg, color = species))+
  ggplot2::geom_line()+
  ggplot2::labs(title="Catch time series") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(.~species)

```

```{r get cluster temp}
num.clusters <- unique(cluster.locs$Cluster_Label)

years.data <- rep(seq(from=2018, to=2023), each = 12)
start.time.interval <- paste(years.data,c("01","02","03","04","05","06","07","08","09","10","11","12"), sep = "-")

time.interval <- 1:length(start.time.interval)

glorys.files <- list.files(path = "/home/atlantis/storagebucket/GLORYS/monthly", pattern="._setlev.nc",full.names = TRUE)

NumberOfCluster <- parallel::detectCores()  #- 1

 parallel::mclapply(time.interval, get_meanclustertemp, glorys.files, cluster.locs, num.clusters, time.interval, start.time.interval, out.dir = "/home/atlantis/storagebucket/GLORYS/clustertemp", mc.cores = NumberOfCluster)
```

Merge together files from multiple decades
```{r merge files, include=FALSE}

esm.slab.files <- list.files(path = "~/storagebucket/ESM_CMIP6/thetao/historical", pattern="*_slab.nc", full.names = TRUE)
esm.slab.future.files <- list.files(path = "~/storagebucket/ESM_CMIP6/thetao/future", pattern="*_slab.nc", full.names = TRUE)

#historical files will be 1990-2024, uses two files from future projections
#realizations to loop through
#can only use realization r1 and r2 because they are the only future realizations
rel.list <- paste0("r",1:2,"i1p1f1")
merged.dir <- "/home/atlantis/storagebucket/ESM_CMIP6/thetao/merged_files/"
dir.create(merged.dir)
#future data are the years from future projections that will be added to historical to match catch data or removed from future data
#data period is entire period covered

lapply(rel.list, merge_files, esm.slab.files, esm.slab.future.files, merged.dir, data.type = "historical", data.period=seq(1990,2024, by=5), data.range = c("199001","202412"))

#50 year projection dataset
lapply(rel.list, merge_files, esm.slab.files, esm.slab.future.files, merged.dir, data.type = "future", data.period=seq(2025,2070, by=5), data.range = c("202501","207412"))

```
